convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for XMA_Range_Channel indicator and includes two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing methods. Entry/exit logic depends on custom indicator buffer values that have no built-in MT5 equivalent.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars before indicator is valid
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade position timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: buy close triggered when Clr[1]<2 and not EMPTY_VALUE (down signal appears); sell close triggered when Clr[1]>1 and not EMPTY_VALUE (up signal appears)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM as lot size); FREEMARGIN/BALANCE=MM as fraction of free margin/balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=MM as fraction of margin minus floating loss. MM=0.1 with LOT mode means 0.1 lots fixed.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads buffer 8 (color/zone buffer) of XMA_Range_Channel. Clr[1]>1 indicates upper channel breakout (buy zone), Clr[1]<2 indicates lower channel breakout (sell zone). Clr[0] value checks confirm transition: buy opens when previous bar entered zone and current bar was not already in zone (Clr[0]<2 or EMPTY). Signal time is set to last bar date + timeframe shift, used by BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen for pending/market order timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose are independent boolean toggles allowing partial strategy activation. Recount flag forces re-evaluation when CopyBuffer fails. LoadHistory is called each tick to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reverse-engineering XMA_Range_Channel buffer 8 logic. The indicator uses SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). Buffer 8 is a color/zone classification buffer, not a standard price series. Must replicate the entire XMA_Range_Channel indicator computation in Python. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GetStartBars - all need Python equivalents. The MarginMode enum provides 5 different money management modes that must each be implemented. Signal bar shift (default 1) means signals are read from the previous completed bar, not the current forming bar.
